dedupe_keys.name: bentley openflows sewer including sewercad and sewergems

description: OpenFlows Sewer is Bentley Systems' commercial software for planning, analysing and designing sanitary and combined sewer systems, and includes the capabilities of SewerCAD and SewerGEMS. It offers dynamic 1D Saint-Venant solvers (implicit, and explicit through EPA-SWMM), integrated 1D/2D surface flooding and inundation analysis, wet-weather runoff, overflow, surcharge and force main modelling, extended-period and continuous simulation, and constraint-based gravity sewer design, with model building from GIS, CAD and terrain data and import and export of SWMM files. Coverage is any sewer network a user builds. It is sold in tiers from small systems (up to 100 pipes) to unlimited networks, and Bentley offers free access for academic use. Caveats: it is paid software and the tier limits pipe count and solvers. Simulation uses: sewer capacity, overflow and urban flood scenarios for wastewater and drainage networks. Related records: EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) and PCSWMM (platform-pcswmm).
